sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:80

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:80:1
items.html: In the form of hooks, for they pass through the membrane of the air, etc., hooks like it, and they are reflected light, for they are Gevurot: The matter of the hairs will be explained further on, in its place: that they are the discernment of the GAR [first three] of Hochma, which needed to clothe in Galgalta and Mocha Stimaa [the concealed brain], at the time the coupling was made upon the screen of phase three, which draws the level of Hochma. But because of the correction of Mem of Tzelem [image], the light went outward, and became a returning surrounding light. For the light departed from their vessels, which are the hairs, and they became surrounding light. And this is what he says: “For they pass through the membrane of the air, etc.” For this correction of Mem of Tzelem is made by force of the membrane of the air, as above in the adjacent item, whereby the light departed from them, and they became, in the discernment of Gevurot, hooks. However, at the time of the coupling, when Arich Anpin and Atik become one, then surrounding light shines in them, and the hairs become Yodin, as will be said below, for then the discernment of the hooks in them descends to Mocha Stimaa.
